title: Absolute tail error from interval error
statement:
Let $
u$ and $	au$ be probability measures on $\mathbb R$, and let $B,t\in\mathbb R$ with $t\ge 0$. If $|
u([-t,t])-	au([-t,t])|\le B$, then the absolute tail probabilities of $
u$ and $	au$ at $t$ differ by at most $B$.
hypotheses_covered: $\nu$ and $\tau$ are probability measures on $\mathbb R$
